newsitem.title: USA: Nat'l Home Health plans to buy two firms.
newsitem.headline: Nat'l Home Health plans to buy two firms.

text.p: National Home Health Care Corp said Wednesday it has entered into a non-binding letter of intent to acquire two home health care companies in Connecticut.
The company did not disclose terms of the proposed deal.
It said the companies it proposes to acquire, which it did not identify, have combined annual revenues of $6-$7 million.
It said completion of the proposed transaction is subject to signing of a binding acqusition agreement, approval by regulators and other conditions.
If those hurdles were met, it said it expects the deal would be completed in August.
National Healthcare provides nursing and paraprofessional home health care services in New York and Connecticut.
